name: Ecchi na Menu Hajimemashita! ~Yariman JK no FamiRes Gohoushi Arbeit~
original_name: エッチなメニューはじめました！～ヤリマンＪＫのファミレスご奉仕アルバイト～
source:
Flirting with handsome customers, calling their boyfriends during work hours and sneaking bites of the food meant for customers. Thanks to the self-centered trio of part-time high school girls - Matsuri, Yuika, and Tamako - the family restaurant Maguwaiya is struggling financially. One day, the manager suddenly collapses and is hospitalized, putting the restaurant in a crisis where closure seems inevitable. To protect their cozy hangout and their paychecks, the girls decide to take action. Their plan? To attract male customers by offering a variety of naughty menu choices and rake in the cash! Will their extreme erotic services, quite literally putting their bodies on the line, be able to save Maguwaiya?

[Translated from [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/next_0214/]DMM[/url]]
